docs.text: Globomantics Platform Welcome to the Globomantics platform documentation. This site describes the core services in our logistics and billing platform: Shared utilities ( globomantics_shared ) Customer and shipment data ( globomantics_data ) Analytics and tiering ( globomantics_analytics ) Billing and invoicing ( globomantics_billing ) Plug-in extensions ( globomantics_plugins ) Command-line interface ( globomantics_cli ) Use this documentation as the single source of truth for how the platform is structured and how teams should integrate with it.
